name: Hailey
source:
An extremely well-endowed prostitute in Vargas's employ.

Very popular amongst his top men, Hailey commands a high price, as well as much respect and jealousy from fellow sex workers. 

Has a penchant for revealing black clothing and expensive gold jewelry.

Rumoured to be quite dominant with her clients when given the opportunity.
